notes: 'Automatic' for how many videos are worked on at the same time is now on every page where it helps: Convert & Compress, Trim Ends, Rotate & Crop and the Stabilizer get a new 'Videos at once' setting; the Stitcher's 'Files read at once', 'Scene checks at once' and 'Joins at once', Footage search's 'Videos at once' and Organise's reading and comparing can all run on Automatic; Enhance's 'Automatic' now adjusts while it runs, never above what the graphics card's memory allows. Pages you already set keep their numbers until you choose Automatic (0 shows as 'Automatic').

Automatic finds its level sooner: it starts with 4 when the PC is quiet (2 when it's busy), looks every 10 seconds at first and adds two at a time while the PC is far from full. In a 100-second trim it used to reach 5 at once only as the trim ended.

Tried and left out: decoding on the graphics card while cutting. Starting the graphics card's decoder for each of the many short steps cost more than it saved: a trim of 91 videos took 170 seconds instead of 63-99, and 7 videos failed their check.
